scope: Actual current-source standing and operated frames reviewed for fitting and remaining art defects. No human appearance acceptance, complete laundry workflow, or ledger grant.

mail_telephone.png.observation: Native board and hanging cords are mounted above the chair; cabinet/panel has no formerly observed triangular shading seams. Close operation view remains needed alongside this room view.

operated_house_telephone.png.observation: Caller plug enters the upper-right jack; trunk plug enters lower-left; listening lever is lowered and both cords remain visible. Bright centre hotspot obscures local PBR detail; human acceptance remains open.

operated_mail_bank.png.observation: Open leaves expose separate empty recesses and protruding mail stocks. Bright brass hotspot obscures one label and surface detail; actual collection is separately proved by input and custody checks.

parcel_package.png.observation: Shelves, crossed braces, tied parcels and scale are present around the tiled pier. Parcels and scale remain simplified with sharp edges and sparse material detail.

common_reading.png.observation: Table, chairs, window treatments and sofa occupy the paneled room. Grain is coarse and repetitive; sofa still reads as block forms; room requires narrative dressing and material polish.

common_return.png.observation: Open return door retains casing, paneling and skirting continuity into the parcel area. Wood panel grain repeats strongly; scoped fit review only.

resident_storage.png.observation: Repeated timber bays retain aisle clearance. Grain is oversized and high contrast; post caps are flat gray; floating unit labels require physical mounting and bays need resident-specific stock.

maintenance_shop.png.observation: Workbench and wall tools are mounted with an open standing area. Vise is a simplified block; bench and sparse tool stock need fabrication detail and lived-in dressing.

coal_room.png.observation: Coal sits in timber containment below the chute with a nearby shovel. Chute and shovel have simplified forms; seam, fastener and coal contact detail remain unfinished.

repaired_panel.png.observation: Open panel exposes fuse sockets, one fitted upper fuse and retained lower fuse stock. Cabinet, conductors and fittings are present; bright enamel hotspots flatten close detail.

laundry_airer.png.observation: Raised airer has visible suspension runs, slats and hanging cloth. Pulley housings remain rectangular blocks and textiles are simplified flat folds.

laundry_washers.png.observation: Wringer sits over lidded metal tub on feet near retained supply runs. Tub finish is smooth and broad; wringer stock, bearings, drive and attachments still need convincing fabrication detail.

washer_lid_clearance.png.observation: Partial lid pose and wringer remain distinct from the adjacent wall and supply runs. This is a partial motion review, not proof of a complete washing workflow.

airer_lowered.png.observation: Lowered slatted rack, suspension cords and hanging cloth are visible above the tubs and taps. This shows reached pose; pulley geometry, cloth thickness and finish remain polish work.
